question: Does a learned full first-passage/reset state improve actual addressed content/control utility over the strongest fitted ordinary candidate under common information?
scope: Finite supplied-address symbolic owner task. No real AV, learned semantic routing, full financial parameter training, production, energy or GPU qualification.
checkpoints: Terminal update64 only; no test-based checkpoint or hyperparameter selection.
owner: Unchanged R15 forty-state law, theta=(.30,.018); full natural hits, recovery and repeated events. Owner receives no trained model state. Actor sees initial public codes, public WRITE, typed routing, query alias map and times; no hidden paths, scores, targets, fit or owner IDs.
query_semantics: Six queries in train/validation/IID/OOD;24 in long pressure. From query start, STOP forecasts common deadline; READ buys one high-quality four-token observation at deadline and updates memory. All worlds advance to same deadline even after STOP. No global multi-query optimality claim.
price: READ pays original .07*public price scale + .003*query duration. STOP pays0. All neural candidates have same opportunities and raw data; selected purchases affect later histories.
ordinary_information: Every core is constructed with the same public Q and metadata. Strong ordinary pool includes same-Q HMM computational realization, fitted GRU, stable dense SSM and typed cache. No HMM exclusion after outcomes.
full_posterior: Forty-dimensional normalized conditional state of an explicit LEARNED latent intervention/emission model, not the exact physical owner posterior. PublicWRITE code y supplies column-softmaxW(:,y) over latentcode while keepingphase; READ uses row-normalized .01+.96*softmaxW(j,:) emission; time exp(exp(log_scale)*Q*dt). head_parameter_fairness: Head initialization and symbol encoder are shared across all kinds. Hidden width40. Actual family parameter counts, persistent state, compute, all fitting/validation/test and failures reported; matched updates are not matched CPU or parameter count.
learning: Separate optimizer and state trajectory per core/control/fit. Common complete offline training collection purchases every possible query READ; logical collection fees counted once as common dataset investment. Class loss uses chosen-history prediction plus .25 supervised potential-READ loss. Unchosen observed tokens affect auxiliary training loss only, never actor history. Value actions are discrete, detached; no policy-gradient/global optimality claim.
light: Training explores independent READ Bernoulli.5 across queries. Validation selects one of fixed price thresholds [-1,.05,.10,.20,1000] on net utility, then CE, then fixed priority. This is supplied finite light-controller family, not a learned optimal controller.
value: Warmup16 updates uses same exploration; thereafter myopic current-query controller enumerates4 possible READ tokens. Uses classifier predictive probabilities and public .97/.01 channel, computes expected post-observation correctness minus actual price. Exact ties STOP. It does not receive the actual token before choice.
selection: All80 independent fits complete before tests open. Per fit and control select ordinary family by validation utility, then CE, then fixed order HMM/GRU/SSM/cache. Train/val identities and all checkpoints frozen in SELECTION_FREEZE before test generation. The prepare process exits before tests. Root must remotely publish SELECTION_FREEZE and bind its SHA256 in POSTTRAIN_PUBLICATION before confirmation starts.
primary_gate: IID and OOD D-B utility each mean>=.01, paired-fit two-sided Student t95 lower>0, exact paired signflip Holm across2domains<.05. Unit8fits. All A/B/C/D andinteraction reported. Same-Q HMM reference mandatory. Original gate is unchanged; a result against validation-selected ordinary is not exclusive representability proof.
long_pressure: Predeclared exploratory24-query transfer, no separate acceptance claim; symbolic alias mapping is supplied and static.
factorized_intervention: Post-training sameweights evaluation projects phase/content joint to product of its two marginals after each query advance/READ, retaining typed memory. Not independently retrained closure or necessity proof.
failure_rule: Any nonfinite/failed job stops campaign and retains outputs; no successful-subset core result. All candidate/validation thresholds and factorization test compute counted. No adding test training after failure.
cost: Linux wait4 full single worker includes interpreter/Torch imports, data preparation, every candidate/threshold/checkpoint, tests, ablation and output. Logical observation fees separate. Parent/developer/auditor costs explicit, no joule inference.
